purpose: Opt-in raw-only carrier-code leveling for the native Phase12 graph. This is a signal/arc preprocessing candidate, not a new free graph state.

archive_inventory.selection_method: ZIP central-directory metadata and existing role records only; no payload member was opened by this selection

split_audit.strict_definition: A route is ineligible when any phone on that route has prior truth evidence or a prior validation/holdout/test role; exact unused identity is insufficient.
split_audit.smoke_reuse_reason: The exact mi8 identity is absent from the positive truth-use inventory, but the same route has prior pixel5 truth evidence. It is therefore not a fresh validation asset and its truth must not be materialized or scored.
split_audit.required_action: Do not open ground_truth.csv in this phase; a genuinely route-disjoint validation asset is required for any accuracy comparison.

observability_audit.bias_state_reason: A constant per-satellite/signal code bias is confounded with the epoch receiver clock and constellation/signal bias directions. Raw code alone does not identify it; a weak prior would select the gauge rather than measure multipath.
observability_audit.selected_form: causal carrier-code leveling; no additional graph state
observability_audit.observable_quantity: ADR phase increment within one continuous satellite/signal arc provides relative code change; the first code observation anchors the absolute level.
observability_audit.limitations: Leveling cannot recover an absolute code bias and assumes short-arc ionosphere/multipath divergence is bounded. A truth-free innovation report and fail-closed reset contract are required.

candidate_contract.signal_scope: Galileo E1 only; GPS and secondary signals remain byte-identical to Phase12 input
candidate_contract.window_interpretation: maximum consecutive one-Hz samples, matching the existing frozen Hatch-30 development contract
candidate_contract.first_or_reset_row: emit raw pseudorange and start a new arc
candidate_contract.phase_units: Android AccumulatedDeltaRangeMeters is already metres; no cycles-to-metres conversion is applied to the increment
fail_closed: clock count vector missing in Android mode

must_hold: Phase12 factors/settings unchanged except E1 pseudorange values
finite all epochs and keyed output
nonzero eligible E1 arc/update counts when present
fallback is exact Phase12 input/recipe on contract failure
structural_gate.failure_action: record No-Go or structural blocker; do not score overlapping-route truth

commands.truth_evaluation: not authorized: no route-disjoint unused validation asset exists
